description: PhytoMethods V2.3 科学证据穿透与文献原始出处索引

records.claim: String Graph 传递边约简定理：若存在路径 u -> w -> v 且偏移相容，则边 u -> v 为拓扑与序列冗余边，边数上限降为线性规模
records.citation: Myers EW. (2005). The fragment assembly string graph. Bioinformatics, 21(suppl_2), ii79–ii85.

records.claim: 参考无关单碱基错误率与 Phred QV 数学反演公式：E = 1 - (K_shared / K_total)^(1/k), QV = -10 * log10(E)
records.citation: Rhie A, Walenz BP, Koren S, Phillippy AM. (2020). Merqury: reference-free quality, completeness, and phasing assessment for genome assemblies. Genome Biology, 21(1), 245.
records.sectionLocator: Methods: Base accuracy and QV calculation

records.claim: 三维基因组染色质接触概率幂律衰减模型 P(s) ∝ s^(-α)，分形球模型下 α ≈ 1.0，平衡球模型下 α ≈ 1.5
records.citation: Lieberman-Aiden E, van Berkum NL, Williams L, et al. (2009). Comprehensive mapping of long-range interactions reveals folding principles of the human genome. Science, 326(5950), 289–293.
records.sectionLocator: Scaling of contact probability with genomic distance

records.claim: YaHS 多分辨率迭代加权拟合与内部接触密度断崖式骤降侦测切除错组装算法
records.citation: Zhou C, McCarthy SA, Durbin R. (2023). YaHS: yet another Hi-C scaffolding tool. Bioinformatics, 39(1), btac808.
records.sectionLocator: Methods: Contact matrix construction & Error correction

records.claim: 四倍体马铃薯全 48 条染色体单倍型无混杂组装与等位有害突变机制解析
records.citation: Sun H, Jiao WB, Krause K, et al. (2022). Chromosome-scale and haplotype-resolved genome assembly of a tetraploid potato cultivar. Nature Genetics, 54(3), 342–348.

records.claim: Verkko 混合长读段组装引擎：以 HiFi 建立同聚物压缩 MBG 图，并以 ONT 超长读段穿透着丝粒与复杂异染色质闭合 T2T
records.citation: Rautiainen M, Nurk S, Walenz BP, et al. (2023). Telomere-to-telomere assembly of diploid chromosomes with Verkko. Nature Biotechnology, 41(7), 1017–1024.

records.claim: Lander-Waterman 测序统计学模型：碱基覆盖泊松分布 P(X=k)=e^(-C)*C^k/k! 与缺口概率 P(X=0)=e^(-C)
records.citation: Lander ES, Waterman MS. (1988). Genomic mapping by partial digestion, random clones, libraries, and interrupted mapping: Theoretical considerations. Genomics, 2(3), 231–239.

records.claim: Hifiasm 官方 v0.12 玉米 B73 实测性能基准：2.2 Gb 基因组, 22x HiFi, 48 线程, 5.1h Wall-clock, 203.2 CPU 小时, 68 GB 内存, Contig N50 36.7 Mb
records.citation: Hifiasm official release benchmark & Cheng et al. Nature Methods (2021)
records.sectionLocator: GitHub repository README Benchmark Table Row: Maize B73

records.claim: EDTA 整合 LTR_retriever、TIR-Learner、HelitronScanner 并结合 CDS 基因过滤与 RepeatModeler2，建立高特异性植物转座子库
records.citation: Ou S, Su W, Liao Y, et al. (2019). Benchmarking transposable element annotation methods for creation of a streamlined, comprehensive pipeline. Genome Biology, 20(1), 275.

records.claim: Kimura 2-parameter 距离推断 LTR 插入年代 T = K / (2μ)，精准识别完整 LTR-RT 结构
records.citation: Ou S, Jiang N. (2018). LTR_retriever: Highly accurate de novo identification of intact LTR retrotransposons. Plant Physiology, 176(2), 1410–1422.
records.sectionLocator: Materials & Methods: Age estimation of LTR-RTs

records.claim: BRAKER3 全自动集成 GeneMark-ETP、AUGUSTUS 与 TSEBRA，无需预设训练集即可实现高精度真核结构基因预测
records.citation: Gabriel L, Hoff KJ, Brůna T, et al. (2024). BRAKER3: Fully automated genome annotation using RNA-seq and protein evidence with GeneMark-ETP, AUGUSTUS, and TSEBRA. Genome Research, 34(5), 727–740.
records.sectionLocator: Results: Annotation performance on plant genomes

records.claim: 基于最大流网络优化剪接图求解转录本异构体，支持高保真长读段转录组比对与内含子链推断
records.citation: Kovaka S, Zimin AV, Pertea GM, et al. (2019). Transcriptome assembly from RNA-seq data with StringTie-2. Genome Biology, 20(1), 278.

records.claim: InterProScan 5 分布式集成 14 成员数据库 Profile HMM 与特征模型，将蛋白分类至 InterPro 条目并映射至 GO/Pathway
records.citation: Jones P, Binns D, Chang HY, et al. (2014). InterProScan 5: genome-scale protein function classification. Bioinformatics, 30(9), 1236–1240.

records.claim: AED 注释编辑距离公式 AED = 1 - 0.5 * (|E_pred ∩ E_est|/|E_pred| + |E_pred ∩ E_est|/|E_est|)，定量表征预测模型与外部实验证据吻合度
records.citation: Eilbeck K, Moore B, Holt C, Yandell M. (2009). Quantitative measures for the management and comparison of annotated genomes. BMC Bioinformatics, 10, 67.
records.sectionLocator: Methods: Calculation of Annotation Edit Distance

records.claim: 基于 OMA 层次化直系同源群 HOGs 评估植物蛋白质组完整性、谱系一致性与潜在共生菌污染
records.citation: Nevers Y, Rossier V, Altenhoff A, et al. (2024). Quality assessment of proteomes using OMArk. Nature Biotechnology, 42.

records.claim: Heaps' law 幂律判据：增量 Δn = κ * N^(-α)，累计泛基因 n = κ' * N^γ (γ = 1 - α)，当 α < 1 (γ > 0) 时判定为开放型泛基因组
records.citation: Tettelin H, Riley D, Cattuto C, Medini D. (2008). Comparative genomics: the bacterial pan-genome. Current Opinion in Microbiology, 11(5), 472–477.

records.claim: AnchorWave 采用保守编码外显子共线锚定与两段仿射间隙惩罚 (2-piece WFA)，专用于植物高转座子富集与古多倍化全基因组比对
records.citation: Song B, Marco-Sola S, Moretti M, et al. (2022). AnchorWave: Sensitive alignment of genomes with diverse karyotypes and whole-genome duplication. PNAS, 119(1), e2113075119.
records.sectionLocator: Algorithm Overview & Two-piece affine gap formulation

records.claim: SyRI 利用有向无环图最大权重共线路径动态规划算法解析五大结构重排 (SYN, INV, TRANS, DUP, HDR)，并在拟南芥 F2 重组群体证实 92.3% 预测易位
records.citation: Goel M, Sun H, Jiao WB, Schneeberger K. (2019). SyRI: finding Rome in the clouds of pangenomes: finding structural variation in genome alignments. Genome Biology, 20(1), 277.
records.sectionLocator: Results & Methods: Identification of syntenic paths

records.claim: cuteSV 基于长读段比对特征签名提取、变异类型特异空间聚类与断裂点多步迭代细化，实现高灵敏度结构变异检测
records.citation: Jiang T, Liu Y, Jiang Y, et al. (2020). Long-read-based human genomic structural variation detection with cuteSV. Genome Biology, 21(1), 189.

records.claim: Minigraph-Cactus 结合宏观 SV 骨架与 Cactus 局部全碱基对齐，构建高分辨率植物变异诱导图并一键生成 Giraffe 索引
records.citation: Hickey G, Monlong J, Ebler J, et al. (2023). Pangenome graph construction from genome alignments with Minigraph-Cactus. Nature Biotechnology, 42, 1464–1473.

records.claim: Giraffe 利用 GBWT 单倍型压缩索引与 Snarl 距离索引，将图泛基因组短读段比对速度提升至线性比对器相当水平
records.citation: Sirén J, Monlong J, Chang X, et al. (2021). Pangenomics enables genotyping of complex structural variants in 5202 diverse human genomes. Science, 374(6574), abg8871.

records.claim: ODGI 采用动态紧凑图内存模型与 Hilbert/SGD 拓扑降维排序，支持全景一维无偏平铺可视化与局部候选基因子图切片
records.citation: Guarracino A, Heumos S, Nahnsen S, et al. (2022). ODGI: understanding pangenome graphs. Bioinformatics, 38(13), 3319–3326.
